nixfred.name: Fred Nix
nixfred.writeup: Wrote Blip and maintains it, reviewing and merging every contribution below. His own pull requests include #141, seven fixes from a whole project review, and #142, which lets Mark all read work while Blip says ALL CAUGHT UP.

Fileri.name: Erik Fillipsveen
Fileri.writeup: The largest contributor by merged PRs. Made Blip usable from the keyboard with a bubble cursor and paging (#37, #39, #56), a draft kept per conversation (#41), and tapbacks from the message menu (#116, #117), and fixed how unsent messages, app cards and stickers show up (#32, #34, #68).

ianswope.name: Ian Swope
ianswope.writeup: Tightened toasts and read state: no toast for the open conversation (#76), no duplicates on extra monitors (#85), none for a message already read elsewhere (#95), and clicking one opens its conversation (#136). Also made the panel open faster (#88, #98), kept security codes out of the environment (#73) and fixed tapbacks on a macOS 27 gateway (#138).

jondkinney.name: Jon Kinney
jondkinney.writeup: Built the read only contact review, with a duplicate scan, full source card details and vCard export (#24, #59, #60, #61). Also kept failed sends visible with a reason (#50), added Ctrl+1 to 9 pinned shortcuts (#53) and Retina scale media (#23).

jefehoser.name: Danny Cecil
jefehoser.writeup: Polished the app window and composer. Long text wraps and copied files attach (#28), group photos are found and retried (#29), the app comes back on its last workspace without stealing focus (#48, #87), and Super+M no longer closes unrelated windows (#93).

zachwilke.name: Zach Wilke
zachwilke.writeup: Worked on speed and attachments: instant sends and resolved duplicate Contacts cards (#43), a startup toll removed (#83), animated GIFs that stay animated (#81) and messages that carry several files (#82). Also moved timestamps across the bridge as UTC (#80).

damonjanis.name: Damon Janis
damonjanis.writeup: Made read state reliable by syncing it through a durable, verified queue (#120), with fixes for the unread badge (#101) and for acknowledging read pushes only after they finish (#102). Added Mark as Unread and Mark as Read (#121) and Pin and Hide Alerts (#122) to the conversation menu.

adamgamble.name: Adam Gamble
adamgamble.writeup: Fixed early rendering and contact bugs: iPhone photos honour EXIF orientation (#9), bubble corners are square (#10), Family Sharing contact stores are ignored (#19) and pinned conversations survive shallow polls (#22). Also added the security code toast, with click to copy and a hotkey to type it (#35).

johanthoren.name: Johan Thorén
johanthoren.writeup: Shaped the first app window: it fills its window like other Omarchy windows (#7), has live search and Super+M keys (#12) and jumps to a thread with 1 to 9 (#13).

joshhattan.name: joshhattan
joshhattan.writeup: Fixed window placement so manual moves stick and the popout opens on the clicked screen (#109), and made security code autofill type the code when Gecko ignores set_text_contents (#110).

followbl.name: Brad Larson
followbl.writeup: Kept Hyprland stable around displays that are off: no leader without a real screen (#113) and no floating window move when a workspace has no monitor (#128).

gjouret.name: Guido Jouret
gjouret.writeup: Fixed scrolling. Wheel and touchpad scroll now apply the delta 1 to 1 (#114), and mouse wheel notches glide through a smoothScroll setting (#115).

bbishdotdev.name: Brenden Bishop
bbishdotdev.writeup: Added security code offers beside the focused field (#92).

badenpiland.name: Baden
badenpiland.writeup: Added prefer_imessage=on in bridge.conf, which keeps mixed one to one chats on iMessage (#96).

Kb2uka.name: Kb2uka
Kb2uka.writeup: Added saving new contacts through the Mac bridge (#91).

Fail-Safe.name: Mark B
Fail-Safe.writeup: Added allowlist notification controls to the conversation menus (#148), so toasts can be switched on or off per conversation without editing the file.

joshuaswarren.name: Joshua Warren
joshuaswarren.writeup: Added hiding of Spam and unknown sender chats through bridge.conf (#49).

jzetterman.name: John Zetterman
jzetterman.writeup: Made Blip survive the host's ssh agent and the bar's PATH (#140).

bndnsmth.name: Brandon Smith
bndnsmth.writeup: Kept the active conversation selected in the sidebar (#134).

brightball.name: Barry Jones
brightball.writeup: Fixed a unified SMS chat row turning an iMessage DM green (#147).

chadhs.name: Chad Stovern
chadhs.writeup: Fixed blip-setup mangling bridge.conf values that contain 2, 7 or x (#124).

cw228.name: cw228
cw228.writeup: Added bin_dir= in bridge.conf so the Linux shims can live outside ~/bin (#100).

dreinecke.name: David Reinecke
dreinecke.writeup: Routed per conversation spawns through a source id seam (#105). Also filed the report that contact photos never showed.

GreyforgeLabs.name: Greyforge Labs
GreyforgeLabs.writeup: Fixed search so sender aware self echoes are preserved (#126).

jaredmoody.name: Jared Moody
jaredmoody.writeup: Made blip-setup read SSH_CONNECTION in a fish safe way (#145).

tlehman.name: Tobi Lehman
tlehman.writeup: Added a mute list that hides spam conversations entirely (#27).

tolewis.name: Unhook Dev
tolewis.writeup: Fixed a bridge bug by keeping one chat row per group, so sends stop failing with error 1728 (#8).

jethrojones.name: Jethro Jones
jethrojones.writeup: Made blip-check probe every Contacts source, not just the first (#2).

daveyb.name: David Benedic
daveyb.writeup: Landed two commits from a closed Windows tray PR (#131): imsg-send now waits 150 seconds for the Messages Automation prompt (sha:b440a49), and a test requires that wait (sha:1b55b40).
